experiment_data.hypothesis: Floor ratio ablation: lowering the MLP floor from 0.4 to 0.3 allows more aggressive pruning of unimportant layers while CKA-only criterion preserves critical structure. If floor=0.3 maintains GSM8K accuracy within 2pp of floor=0.4 baseline, it demonstrates robustness of CKA-guided pruning to floor choice.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/recovery_aware_struct_prune && HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 bash scripts/run_floor_ablation.sh 0.3 0"
